title: Have Susi implement its own improvements using cloud-backed native agents
goal: Connect approved self-improvement tasks to Susi's native agent tool loop with working cloud inference for reasoning and native tools for repository inspection, edits, builds and tests. Claim each task and use a dedicated branch/worktree with AGENTS.md mandates, scoped grants and task commit trailers. Multiple independent improvements may use parallel working models via the existing scheduler. Cloud-generated patches must be applied and executed locally; generated text or a proposed diff is not implemented work. Use A2A external delegation only for a recorded capability gap/fallback and preserve the same mandates. Never edit primary/main or install dev builds into release paths. Hermetic integration tests use temporary repositories and fake models through production orchestration. Implement nonzero tests named cloud_rsi_implementation_* in susi-gawd exercising production wiring.
